name: Curve Finance
description: Creating deep on-chain liquidity using advanced bonding curves

warningBanners.message: Curve Finance updated their website to curve.finance. Update all your bookmarks.

methodology.UserFees: Swap and liquidity fees paid by traders. Excludes bribes, which are paid by third parties bidding for gauge votes, not by users.
methodology.Fees: Swap and liquidity fees charged by Curve pools, plus bribes paid to veCRV voters. Fee rates are set per pool - around 0.01%-0.04% on stable pools and up to a few percent on volatile pools.
methodology.Revenue: The share of pool fees kept by the protocol rather than paid to liquidity providers - usually half of the fee - plus bribes.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 10% of the protocol's share of pool fees, sent to the Curve DAO treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 90% of the protocol's share of pool fees, distributed to veCRV holders, plus all bribes.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of pool fees paid to liquidity providers - usually half of the fee.

Fees.CurveDEX Swap Fees: Swap and liquidity fees charged by Curve pools

Revenue.CurveDEX Admin Fees: Fees distributed to veCRV holders and protocol treasury

ProtocolRevenue.CurveDEX Admin Fees To Treasury: Fees allocated to the protocol treasury

HoldersRevenue.CurveDEX Fees To veCRV Holders: Fees distributed to veCRV governance token holders

methodology.Fees: All borrow interest paid by borrowers.
methodology.Revenue: All borrow interest go to protocol treasury + veCRV holders.

Fees.crvUSD Borrow Interest: Borrow interest fees collected and distributed through the FeeSplitter contract (post Oct 2024) and from controller contracts via CollectFees events (pre FeeSplitter).
Fees.crvUSD Management Fees: Uncollected admin fees accrued in controller contracts between start and end of the period.

Revenue.crvUSD Borrow Interest: Borrow interest fees collected and distributed through the FeeSplitter contract (post Oct 2024) and from controller contracts via CollectFees events (pre FeeSplitter).
Revenue.crvUSD Management Fees: Uncollected admin fees accrued in controller contracts between start and end of the period.

methodology.Fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers plus AMM swap fees from LLAMMA liquidation AMMs.
methodology.Revenue: AMM admin fees collected by Curve DAO.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: AMM admin fees collected by Curve DAO.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Borrow interest distributed to lenders plus AMM swap fees distributed to LPs.

Fees.LlamaLend Borrow Interest: Interest paid by borrowers on their loans, accrued daily based on utilization rate
Fees.LlamaLend AMM Swap Fees: Fees from token swaps in LLAMMA (Lending-Liquidating AMM Algorithm) pools used for soft liquidations

Revenue.LlamaLend AMM Admin Fees: Admin share of AMM swap fees collected by Curve DAO

ProtocolRevenue.LlamaLend AMM Admin Fees: Admin share of AMM swap fees collected by Curve DAO

SupplySideRevenue.LlamaLend Lender & LP Revenue: Borrow interest paid to lenders plus AMM swap fees earned by liquidity providers (net of admin fees)

methodology.Fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers plus AMM swap fees from LLAMMA liquidation AMMs.
methodology.Revenue: Borrow admin fees accrued or collected by Curve DAO via per-market fee receivers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Borrow admin fees accrued or collected by Curve DAO via per-market fee receivers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Borrow interest to vault depositors plus AMM swap fees to LLAMMA LPs.
methodology.Volume: Token swap volume on LLAMMA liquidation AMMs during soft liquidations.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Not applicable — protocol fees route to Curve DAO fee receivers, not CRV token holders.
methodology.NotionalVolume: Not applicable — lending protocol with no derivatives notional volume.
methodology.PremiumVolume: Not applicable — lending protocol with no options premium volume.
methodology.OpenInterest: Not applicable — lending protocol with no derivatives open interest.

Fees.LlamaLend Borrow Interest: Net borrow interest from vault pricePerShare accrual plus admin fee changes; can be negative when share price drops.
Fees.LlamaLend AMM Swap Fees: Swap fees from LLAMMA soft-liquidation AMMs. v2 AMMs have no admin fee split; fees go to LPs.

Revenue.LlamaLend Borrow Admin Fees: Admin share of borrow interest accrued in controller.admin_fees or collected via CollectFees.

ProtocolRevenue.LlamaLend Borrow Admin Fees: Admin share of borrow interest routed to the market fee receiver (Curve DAO by default).

SupplySideRevenue.LlamaLend Borrow Interest To Lenders: Net borrow interest to vault depositors (lenders); can be negative when share price drops.
SupplySideRevenue.LlamaLend AMM Swap Fees To LPs: AMM swap fees distributed to LLAMMA liquidity providers.
